day_shape: 74 items: CENTCOM disables Iran-origin cargo vessel M/V Pacific Archer in Gulf of Oman as Tehran vows to break blockade, FT reports ~6 drones suspected of Iran links swarmed RAF Lakenheath, heavy regime 7 Azar Navy Day/Strait of Hormuz messaging, nothing from UK Parliament or State Dept sanctions desk.

threads.label: US blockade enforcement in Gulf of Oman
threads.summary: CENTCOM said it disabled Palau-flagged M/V Pacific Archer with precision munitions after it departed Bandar Abbas and ignored warnings to breach the US naval blockade. Supreme Leader adviser Mohammad Mokhber vowed to break the blockade, and CENTCOM separately rebutted an Iranian commander's claims of seizing US-boarded tankers as fabricated.

threads.label: 7 Azar Navy Day and Strait of Hormuz messaging
threads.summary: Regime channels cycled statements from Army chief Hatami, IRGC commander Vahidi, IRGC's Hasanzadeh, Police chief Radan and judiciary head Araqi marking Navy Day, with Hatami quoted saying the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until Iran's conditions are met. Jerusalem Post reported the IDF remains on high alert with CENTCOM over fears of an Iranian surprise attack.

threads.label: Suspected Iran-linked drones at RAF Lakenheath
threads.summary: The Financial Times reported US forces repelled around six drones near RAF Lakenheath earlier this month in an incident suspected of Iran links, with the drones never recovered. USA Today separately reported Iran threats are among concerns driving Trump officials into military housing, and the Washington Post reported low staffing at US Naval Support Activity Bahrain after Iranian strikes.

threads.label: Iran–Iraq border talks and Mokhber warning
threads.summary: Iraqi and Iranian officials held security talks in Tehran on counterterrorism, smuggling and border control, with Supreme Leader adviser Mohammad Mokhber warning Baghdad not to become a tool of Trump's border policies. Defa Press carried Mokhber's message on Iraq, alongside an opinion piece questioning Iran's ambassador to Pakistan over Ansarallah.

threads.label: Yemen front: Houthi missile, Balhaf hijack, Defa Press claims
threads.summary: Saudi-led coalition forces said they intercepted a Houthi cruise missile fired at Riyadh, and UKMTO reported armed individuals boarded and took control of a cargo ship 64 nautical miles southwest of Balhaf. Defa Press claimed Saudi-backed forces are suffering rapid collapses in southern Yemen with US-supplied weapons captured.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and Lebanon UNIFIL question
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed two operatives working as MSF clinic watchmen in a Gaza City strike and 10 Hamas and PIJ members over the past week, while Defa Press called a strike on Khalil al-Hayya's son's apartment a ceasefire violation. Lebanese PM Nawaf Salam said a French proposal could extend UNIFIL beyond its 31 December mandate deadline.

threads.label: Iran domestic repression and economic strain
threads.summary: Iran International reported Reuters sources saying the flogging of singer Parastoo Ahmadi was meant to deter dissent, the violent transfer of Oscar-nominated screenwriter Mehdi Mahmoudian to Greater Tehran Prison, and a femicide case; IRIB reported the assassination of Sunni cleric Maulawi Bashir Salahzahi in Sistan and Baluchestan. Iran's central bank governor acknowledged purchasing-power erosion with the dollar above 2.93 million rials, and OPEC+ reportedly held output steady amid Iran war uncertainty.

Yemen's war propaganda headquarters released images of Saudi-backed mercenaries being pushed back from the most important positions and mountain ranges in the al-Mudarabah area and Ras al-Ara to the Kharz camp and the Gulf of Aden coastline. events.summary_en: How to receive physical delivery of Central Bank coin sale-leaseback securities. The Central Bank announced: Individuals who have purchased parallel coin sale-leaseback securities from the Central Bank, if they wish to receive physical delivery of the coin, must register their request at a brokerage firm today and tomorrow. These securities have a three-month maturity and if no physical delivery request is made, they will be settled in rials at market price with the customer on the maturity date. Physical delivery of coins is available only to applicants holding a multiple of 1,000 securities and is conditional upon registering a physical coin delivery request at a brokerage firm up to 10 days before the maturity date.

events.summary_en: Wife of Martyr Mohagheghi: I am raising Ali's trusts with heart and soul. The daughter of Martyr Ali Mohagheghi, a volunteer Basiji in the inspection of Haftir Theatre, was born eight months after her father's martyrdom. The martyr's wife said the name 'Hana' was chosen for her; a name her father had loved for his daughter before his martyrdom. The wife of Martyr Mohagheghi added: When I went to bid farewell at the Ascension of the Martyrs, I told him that our wishes had not yet been fulfilled; our son wanted a sister and you also wanted a daughter. Two weeks later I found that his wish had been granted, but he was not there to see this day.
